name: influee
description: Run Influee UGC and creator campaigns from ChatGPT: campaigns, creators, collaborations, messages, tasks, content review, briefs, brands and products in your Influee brand account.

interface.longDescription:
Run your UGC and creator campaigns on Influee straight from ChatGPT.

Influee is where e-commerce brands and agencies brief creators, pick who to work with, ship products and get back ready-to-run video ads and social content. With Influee in ChatGPT you can:

- See how your campaigns are doing: state, recruitment, collaborations and post results.
- Clear your to-do list: shipments, tracking links, creator codes and content waiting for review.
- Message creators, send offers and move deadlines.
- Set up draft campaigns, briefs and products.
- Find delivered videos in your content library and read their transcripts.

Sign in with your Influee brand account; ChatGPT only sees what that account can see. Anything that sends a message or offer, approves content or deletes data asks for your confirmation first.
capabilities: List, create, update, duplicate and submit campaigns
Search creators and manage creator lists
Review proposals, send or withdraw offers and move deadlines
Read and send messages to creators, or save drafts
Confirm shipments and deliveries, add tracking links and creator codes
Approve delivered content or request revisions
Browse the content library and read transcripts
Manage briefs, creative assets and brief documents
View invoices and payment history (company admins)
defaultPrompt: What tasks are waiting for me on Influee today?
Summarize my active campaigns and their collaborations.
Show the newest videos in my content library.

positive.description: Campaign overview. The test account has at least one active campaign with collaborations.
positive.prompt: Summarize my active campaigns on Influee and how many collaborations each one has.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's active campaigns by title with brand, state, budget and recruitment status, and gives the number of collaborations per campaign. Only campaigns from the connected account appear.

positive.description: Pending to-do list. The test account has open tasks such as a proposal, a shipment or content waiting for approval.
positive.prompt: What tasks are waiting for me on Influee today?
positive.expected_behavior: Groups the pending tasks by type (for example proposals, shipments, content approvals) with the campaign and creator for each, and suggests the next step for each one. Nothing is changed in the account.

positive.description: Message a creator, with confirmation before sending. The test account has a collaboration with the demo creator Sofia.
positive.prompt: Find my conversation with Sofia and send her: "Hi! Just checking when you'll deliver the video. Thanks!"
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the conversation with Sofia, asks the user to confirm, then sends the message. It appears in the conversation in the Influee dashboard.

positive.description: Content library and transcript. The test account has delivered videos with transcripts.
positive.prompt: Show the newest videos in my Influee content library and give me the transcript of the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the most recent delivered content items with type, creator and format, then returns the readable transcript text of the first video. Nothing is changed in the account.

positive.description: Create a draft campaign. The test account has a brand and a product.
positive.prompt: Create a draft UGC video campaign for my brand called "Autumn launch" with 5 creators.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the brand, asks for any required detail it is missing, then asks the user to confirm and creates a draft campaign titled "Autumn launch" for 5 content creators. Returns the campaign ID and a link to open it in the Influee dashboard. The campaign stays a draft and is not submitted.

negative.description: Payment outside Influee. The plugin has no tool that sends money.
negative.prompt: Send $500 to the creator on my latest collaboration through PayPal.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any write tool. Explains that it can't send money and offers to show the collaboration instead.

negative.description: Another company's data. Tools only return data for the brands of the signed-in account.
negative.prompt: Show me the campaigns and creator rates of another brand that is not in my Influee account.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not try to retrieve the other company's data. Explains that it can only see the brands and campaigns in the connected Influee account.

negative.description: General marketing request unrelated to the Influee account. No account data is needed.
negative.prompt: Write me five catchy Instagram captions for a coffee brand.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers directly without calling any Influee tool, because the request does not involve the user's campaigns, creators or content.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything and takes no payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: manage Influee campaigns, creators, offers, messages, tasks, content review, the content library, briefs, brands and products from ChatGPT.
